classification.positive: candidate passes all absolute gates and final candidate-minus-control <= -0.001 initial pots

crossing: first complete target-pair iteration at or above each charged node-work label

input.status: structurally inspected known case; no policy outcome at publication

metrics: exact restricted-game NashConv/2 at current and linear average in chips and fraction of initial pot
candidate-minus-control paired difference at every work label
whole and post-initial-river positive-average uniform-reach coverage
recall violations, turn collision inventory, exact/abstract rows, table bytes, actual work and overshoot
whole path runtime, hardware and peak RSS

primary_metric: final linear-average exact restricted-game NashConv/2 in chips and fraction of initial pot; lower better
